outline:
隨著人工智慧、5G通訊網路與感測技術的迅速發展，智慧物聯網應用已成為產業關注的核心領域。本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧與物聯網的技術，並將其應用於創新發展。課程內容涵蓋物聯網與人工智慧的基礎概念、智慧物聯網的實作技術，幫助學生理解關鍵技術並具備實作能力。學生將學習設計與開發基於感測器與Arduino的嵌入式系統，熟悉物聯網架構，並透過各類通訊模組將感測數據傳輸至雲端平台。最後，課程將介紹如何運用人工智慧技術實現智慧化物聯網應用。
With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, 5G communication networks, and sensing technologies, smart IoT applications have become a key focus in the industry. This course aims to equip students with AI technologies and apply them to innovative IoT developments. The curriculum covers fundamental concepts of IoT and AI, as well as hands-on smart IoT implementation, enabling students to understand key technologies and develop practical skills. Students will learn to design and develop embedded systems based on sensors and Arduino, familiarize themselves with IoT architecture, and transmit sensor data to cloud platforms through various communication modules. Finally, the course will introduce the development of expert systems using AI technologies to achieve intelligent IoT applications.
